title: Austin Housing: Non-Profit Funds, Tax Relief
summary:
*   **Discussed managing income generated by non-profit housing programs**, considering new recommendations.
*   **Reviewed a contract and lease agreement** with an entity named FREEE.
*   **Debated policies for residential property tax abatement**, a potential form of tax relief for homeowners.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
HOUSING SUBCOMMITTEE MEETING
September 11, 1991 - 11:30 A.M.
MUNICIPAL BUILDING ANNEX
Mayor Pro Tern Urdy, Councilmembers Nofziger, Larson and Garcia met as members of the
Housing Subcommittee.
After approving minutes of the August 14, 1991 meeting the subcommittee discussed and
heard staff reports on the following: Discussion and Recommendation on Managing Non-Profit
Program Income Discussion on Contract and Lease with FREEE
Discussion on Residential Tax Abatement
Monthly Housing Report
A more detailed set of minutes is on file in the Department of Planning and Development.
Copy of those minutes is also on file in the City Clerk's office.
At 1:06 P.M. the meeting was adjourned.
